name: s81su_smhr
structural_change: S81U-SMH2 (10-17): root regional cluster (x1 per head) of the split per-head SM subtree (see s81su_smhq): row sum smc + max/den root smr with their SRL link, own clock pin + registered reset relay; quad links arrive registered (station 1 in the quad), max/den broadcast leaves registered. SMHKP4 10-18: closed 1ced40b32 view native FAIL: (1) capture 236 > 190 on 125 inputs = same GRT io_ref fallback as smhq (reference rr0 reset relay instead of the input pin flops; 252 GRT hold buffers) -> refglob u_ld* (1,024 q_mx/q_e input pin flops); (2) routed TT pin-flop spread 87 (575..662) vs 30.5 at CTS: neighbouring N-face flops on different count-bisection trunk branches (clkbuf_sp_N150 vs N75 paths) diverge under routed RC because the leaf pads were equalised at placement parasitics -> symmetric insertion-aware spine (OT_SPINE_SYM + tree-shared pads, as qfd_slab_pg_cl) so every branch carries matched trunk wire.
why_floorplan: smc + smr side by side on the 43.2 lattice between a 43-um S band (q_e + control stations, clk) and a 43-um N band (q_mx stations); pin-bound: ~590 pins S (1.7/um) + 512 q_mx pins N (1.5/um), the quads sit on both sides of the root in the slice; 346 x 216 um. g1 (one face, 346 x 251) failed fill 31% (pin demand S 78%).

reroute_reason.why: SMHKP4 10-18 (lanes/S81-SMHKP4.md): native capture 235.7 > 190 on 125 inputs (GRT io_ref fallback to reset relay rr0, 252 GRT hold buffers) + routed TT pin-flop spread 87.0 > 80 (CTS 30.5: count-bisection trunk branches equalised at placement parasitics diverge under routed RC)
reroute_reason.fix: refglob u_ld* (1,024 input pin flops) + symmetric insertion-aware spine with tree-shared pads (OT_SPINE_SYM/TREE_PAD/SAFE_BALANCE): gate insertion 501.8 TT, spread 28.7/21.5, GRT 0

why_clock: SMH 10-18: clock = balanced spine with child-insertion leaf targets from each child's ROUTED boundary-register insertion (child_clock_ref boundary), so the glue pin flops and the children's pin flops tick together. The 10-17 g3 TritonCTS trial (insertion-cap driven) gave pin-flop spread 144 ps; the g2 spine gave 24.8 ps (insertion > 300 ps is guidance under 0dq).
